## MiniMax H3 Chili API

MiniMax H3 Chili is a text to video, image to video and reference to video model by MiniMax, available on the Venice API as `minimax-h3-chili-text-to-video`. The provider of this model may retain prompt data (though it is anonymized by Venice). For sensitive content, use a private model.

MiniMax H3 Chili is an uncensored version of MiniMax's H3 video model. This text-to-video variant generates 4- to 15-second clips at 768p with native audio.

### MiniMax H3 Chili API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `minimax-h3-chili-text-to-video` | Text to video | Anonymized | from $0.0347 / sec |
| `minimax-h3-chili-image-to-video` | Image to video | Anonymized | from $0.0394 / sec |
| `minimax-h3-chili-reference-to-video` | Reference to video | Anonymized | from $0.0483 / sec |

Clip prices for `minimax-h3-chili-text-to-video` with audio:

| Duration | 768p |
|---|---|
| 4s | $0.12 |
| 5s | $0.15 |
| 10s | $0.35 |
| 15s | $0.60 |

Any length from 4 to 15 seconds.

### How to use the MiniMax H3 Chili API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue` with `"model": "minimax-h3-chili-text-to-video"` and your API key.

```bash
# 1. Queue the job (returns a queue_id)
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "minimax-h3-chili-text-to-video",
    "prompt": "Slow aerial drone shot over a misty mountain valley at golden hour",
    "duration": "5s",
    "resolution": "768P",
    "aspect_ratio": "16:9"
  }'

# 2. Poll until the MP4 is ready (JSON with the status until then)
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/retrieve \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "model": "minimax-h3-chili-text-to-video", "queue_id": "<queue_id>" }' --output video.mp4

# If the queue response has a download_url, retrieve only reports the
# status: download the MP4 from that URL once it is COMPLETED.
```
